problem: The LibreCAD_3 adapter ignored the writer-owned IMAGEDEF, leaving its pixel dimensions and source display scalars zeroed and conflating separate definitions with the same path.
implementation: Capture shared source definition scalars and a bounded path, then use the codec's source-generation definition plan when available. Initialize new-image definitions, report unmodeled source metadata and unsupported fallbacks, reserve original definition handles, and report removal of stale source dictionary entries. Conflicting captured source identities fail before the write; older codec headers use the filename fallback and report identity loss.
validation: Scalar-loss and same-path definition controls failed before the fix. 87 focused IMAGE/persistence tests and 18 layout tests pass, including source fields, new-image defaults, ASCII and binary reopens, source metadata loss reporting, path changes, low source handles, a rejected malformed duplicate-handle input, and removal/copy retry.

Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 verifies two same-path IMAGEs retain distinct definition links, image dimensions, pixel sizes and resolution; low-handle and shared-definition retry outputs also have zero audit errors or fixes.
The independent binary cross-encoding output preserves the same distinct definition fields and links but still needs one orphan paper-space block repair; its raw-source graph loss is reported.
The adapter syntax-checks against the older bundled codec headers with the plan API disabled; older-codec runtime behavior is not qualified.
limits: Source IMAGEDEF/reactor object identities, XDATA, application groups, original dictionary keys and other inbound links are not fully retained. Omitted metadata and source entries are reported; the generated objects are not a full-graph preservation proof.

The source-path capture limit is 4 MiB logical bytes and the definition plan is limited to 100000 identities. These are not total process-memory limits; limit exhaustion and the defensive export-side collision branch are not independently exercised here.
Binary cross-encoding, removed-only images, older-codec runtime, clipped rendering, native producers, and broader graph/platform qualification remain open. No generated drawing was committed.
